blocks.text: Bom Jardim, snorkelling and transfer to Chapada dos Guimarães

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The Word labels this segment Nobres and Chapada dos Guimaraes; it has no title naming Bom Jardim and snorkelling.

blocks.text:
Early departure at 07:00 for the village of Bom Jardim, about 162 km from Cuiabá airport, in the transition zone between the savanna and the Amazon rainforest. The area is known for its clear-water rivers, lakes and caves.

On arrival, walk about 1 km to Aquário Encantado and the Salobra River. Around 2 hours of snorkelling among fish and aquatic plants are planned here.

After lunch, travel to Chapada dos Guimarães. The region’s characteristic rock formations begin to appear along the way. The programme then continues with a visit to Chapada’s historic centre and the Geodesic Centre of South America marker. Check in at Park Eco Lodge, followed by dinner and an overnight stay.
